title: Bunker plugin
description: A social deduction RPG minigame where players must justify their value to survive the apocalypse in a limited-space shelter.
body:
## ☢️ Bunker
Bunker is a thrilling social deduction and role-playing minigame for Minecraft, based on the popular board game of the same name. Players must survive a global apocalypse using their unique character traits, powers of persuasion, and social strategy.

## 🌋 About the Project
The world has been destroyed by a cataclysm. You have found a fallout shelter, but its resources are limited. To survive, the group must decide: who is valuable enough to secure a spot in the bunker, and who will be left outside?

## Key Features:

Unique Characters: Every player receives a random set of cards (Profession, Health, Hobby, Inventory, etc.).

Dynamic Scenarios: Each game begins with a unique disaster that changes the survival conditions.

Voting System: Exile the least useful (or most suspicious) group members through an interactive in-game voting system.

Full Automation: A complete game cycle from lobby countdown to the final victory, featuring automatic inventory and gamemode restoration.

## 🛠 Commands & Permissions
For Players
- /bunker join — Join the game queue.

- /bunker leave — Exit the lobby or the current game (counts as a forfeit if the game is active).

### For Administration 
(Requires permission: bunker.admin)

- /bunker stop — Instantly force-stop the game and return all players to their previous locations.

- /bunker setlobby — Set the lobby waiting point at your current position.

- /bunker setspawn — Set the game spawn point inside the bunker.

- /bunker reload — Reload configuration files and scenarios.


If you need help, you can text me in discord: @ketamy_fe
